rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-032 BeyondTrust bomgar-scc Spawns a Shell Running Host Discovery) OR ABIOC(MP-032 Appliance Service Process Sends Hex-Encoded Hostname as Chunked DNS Labels) OR BIOC(MP-032 bomgar-scc Descendant Writes PHP Files Into the Web Root) OR BIOC(MP-032 Process Executed From a memfd With a Kernel-Thread argv0) OR BIOC(MP-032 bomgar-scc Descendant Opens a Reverse Shell Over dev tcp to Port 4444) OR IOC(aliyundunupdate.xyz)) AND (ABIOC(MP-032 NGFW Recurring Communications From the Appliance to a Rare External IP) OR IOC(134.122.13.34) OR IOC(45.61.150.96) OR IOC(85.155.186.121) OR IOC(9f431d5549a03aee92cfd2bdbbe90f1c91e965c99e90a0c9ad5a001f4e80c350) OR IOC(98a7b0900a9072bb40af579ec372da7b27af12b15868394df51fefe290ab176b)) within 1800s on the same endpoint entity (xdr_data agent_hostname = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw / panw_ngfw_threat_raw endpoint_device_name, the src_host every leg carries) -> one BeyondTrust appliance-compromise incident whose summary names the bomgar-scc lineage, the webshells, the SparkRAT / VShell implants and the C2 destinations.
rules.name: BeyondTrust RS CVE-2026-1731 — bomgar-scc Post-Exploitation and NGFW C2 on One Appliance
